description: Defines the EditorModel class for interacting with the editor UI in end-to-end tests, including methods for editing, saving, and navigating within the editor.

classes.name: EditorModel
classes.description: A class providing methods to interact with the editor interface in automated tests, including editing content, managing tabs, and UI state checks.

methods.name: waitForLoading
methods.description: Waits for the editor to load with specified title and content.

methods.name: waitForUnloading
methods.description: Waits for the editor to unload or become inactive.

methods.name: waitForSaving
methods.description: Waits until the editor's content is saved.

methods.name: isUnloaded
methods.description: Checks if the editor is in an unloaded state.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the editor content.

methods.name: typeTitle
methods.description: Types text into the title field with optional delay.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the main content of the editor.

methods.name: editAndWait
methods.description: Performs an edit action and waits for the editor's date edited timestamp to update.

methods.name: selectAll
methods.description: Selects all text in the editor.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Gets the editor content in HTML or text format.

methods.name: isFocusMode
methods.description: Checks if focus mode is active.

methods.name: isFullscreen
methods.description: Checks if fullscreen mode is active.

methods.name: attachImage
methods.description: Attaches an image from clipboard to the editor.
